contract InvMutTest {
    C c;
    constructor(C _c) { c = _c; }
    function run(
        address maker,
        bool isCall,
        bool isLong,
        address baseAsset,
        uint256 strike,
        uint256 premium,
        uint256 duration,
        uint256 expiration,
        uint256 nonce,
        address[] memory whitelist,
        address[] memory floorTokens,
        C.ERC20Asset[] memory erc20Assets,
        C.ERC721Asset[] memory erc721Assets
    ) public {
        C.Order memory order = C.Order({
            maker: maker,
            isCall: isCall,
            isLong: isLong,
            baseAsset: baseAsset,
            strike: strike,
            premium: premium,
            duration: duration,
            expiration: expiration,
            nonce: nonce,
            whitelist: whitelist,
            floorTokens: floorTokens,
            erc20Assets: erc20Assets,
            erc721Assets: erc721Assets
        });
        C.Order memory flipped = C.Order({
            maker: maker,
            isCall: isCall,
            isLong: !isLong,
            baseAsset: baseAsset,
            strike: strike,
            premium: premium,
            duration: duration,
            expiration: expiration,
            nonce: nonce,
            whitelist: whitelist,
            floorTokens: floorTokens,
            erc20Assets: erc20Assets,
            erc721Assets: erc721Assets
        });
        assert(
            c.hashOrder(order) == c.hashOppositeOrder(flipped) &&
            c.hashOppositeOrder(order) == c.hashOrder(flipped) &&
            (isLong ? c.hashOrder(order) != c.hashOrder(flipped) : c.hashOrder(order) != c.hashOrder(flipped))
        );
    }
}
